description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for a configuration GUI application, including classes for configuration list, items, main window, and related components.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: Subclass of QSettings with additional methods for reading and writing size lists.

classes.name: ConfigList
classes.description: QTreeWidget subclass managing a list of configuration items with various modes and signals.

classes.name: ConfigItem
classes.description: QTreeWidgetItem subclass representing individual configuration entries with icons and hierarchy.

classes.name: ConfigItemDelegate
classes.description: QStyledItemDelegate subclass for editing ConfigItem entries.

classes.name: ConfigInfoView
classes.description: QTextBrowser subclass displaying detailed info about configuration elements.

classes.name: ConfigSearchWindow
classes.description: QDialog subclass providing search functionality within the configuration GUI.

classes.name: ConfigMainWindow
classes.description: QMainWindow subclass serving as the main interface for configuration management.

methods.name: findConfigItem
methods.description: Finds a ConfigItem based on a menu structure.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets selection state for a list item.

methods.name: setRootMenu
methods.description: Sets the root menu for the list.

methods.name: changeValue
methods.description: Changes the value of a ConfigItem.
